verdict:
## QA Findings — Issues Found (not CLEAN)

**1. Overlapping/clipped UI (bug)**
- Bottom center (~x 580–690, y 745–760): the leftover onboarding text **"Skip — use default yard"** collides with the **"☀ Sun"** button — "use de·fault·yard" is rendered *underneath/clipped by* the Sun button. Looks broken. Either remove the skip text (a "Start Designing" modal is already open) or move it clear of the toolbar row.

**2. Confusing within 5 seconds (minor)**
- **Duplicate "Terrain" controls:** a "Terrain" panel sits bottom-left AND a "Terrain" button appears in the bottom toolbar row — a new user can't tell which does what.
- Three separate tip lines stacked inside the modal ("Quick sizes…", "Tip: press ? or F1…", "Your work autosaves…") plus a *fourth* tip below the Back link create text clutter; consolidate to one.
- Stray **"Daytime"** pill floating mid-canvas at top looks like a stuck toast with no context.

**3. Ambiguous/misplaced (minor)**
- The background toolbar (Tape Measure / Excavate / Analyze / Innovate) is visible and interactive-looking while a modal claims "Step 2 of 2" setup is in progress — consider dimming/disabling background UI during onboarding.
- Redundant shortcut guidance: "? or F1" tip in modal duplicates the "Shortcuts" and "Help" items in the top bar.

**What's fine:** top bar, left category sidebar, compass, zoom controls, status bar, and the modal's core content (title, dimension inputs, quick sizes, CTA, Back) are all well-aligned, readable, and none of the sidebar items or inputs are clipped.

**Suggested fixes (in priority order):** remove/position the "Skip — use default yard" text; merge or relabel one of the two Terrain controls; trim modal to one tip line; dim background chrome during onboarding.
